column1: # Cullen (2000) Table A.2: lip parameters of an ARTIFICIAL latex lip pair on a trombone-size mouthpiece, 20 embouchures, TRANSCRIBED from the printed page. Not a player, not a human lip.
# Source: J. S. Cullen, A Study of Brass Instrument Acoustics using an Artificial Lip Reed Mechanism, Laser Doppler Anemometry and Other Techniques, PhD thesis, University of Edinburgh, 2000,

#   Appendix A, Table A.2 'Lip parameters extracted from mechanical response measurements', thesis p.253 (PDF page 259 of the Edinburgh Research Archive file CullenJS_2000redux.pdf, handle 1842/13512).
#   The rig's mouthpiece: rig cup diameter 25.5 mm (Fig 3.5 p.41), internal volume 12.7 ml (p.41), as already cited by the trombone and trumpet heads.

# Caption of the table, paraphrased (this ledger row is facts-only): numbers in bold font are estimates made by extrapolating or interpolating neighbouring measured values (standard font); the thesis used the

#   lip parameters of this table for its figure 3.24. Columns: H0 rest gap (mm), b channel width (mm), fL1 / QL1 / 1/muL1 the OUTWARD-striking resonance (Hz, quality factor, m2/kg), fL2 / QL2 / 1/muL2 the INWARD-striking
#   resonance (a negative 1/mu). No mass is printed, only 1/mu; the uncertainty of every number is UNKNOWN (the thesis states none).

# Method: the page was read on the 300 ppi page image by eye, then checked three ways. (1) the PDF's embedded OCR text: 20 of 20 rows parsed, 0 disagreements; (2) a fresh Tesseract pass on every one of the

#   180 cells: 4 single-digit disagreements (QL1 of embouchures 8, 9, 12 and fL2 of 17: it reads a final 5 as 0 or 9), each resolved by an enlarged view of the cell in favour of the value below; (3) the table's own

#   order: fL1 non-decreasing, H0 strictly decreasing, b non-increasing over embouchures 0 to 19. Bold versus standard font is a mechanical read: the mean stroke width of the ink in each cell (2 x area / boundary length at 300 ppi)

#   separates the two classes (bold 5.0 to 5.8 px, standard 3.7 to 4.3 px in the H0, b, fL2, QL2 and 1/muL2 columns), confirmed on a magnified crop. The columns fL1, QL1 and 1/muL1 have NO bold entry: they are
#   standard font, i.e. MEASURED, on all 20 rows.

# What is measured and what is estimated (from the bold flags below): fL1, QL1, 1/muL1 are measured for every embouchure. H0 and b are measured only for embouchures 3, 7 and 11 and are interpolated or extrapolated
#   (bold) for the other 17, including embouchure 19 (H0 0.25 mm, b 9 mm) and embouchure 0 (H0 0.70 mm, b 18 mm). fL2, QL2, 1/muL2 are measured on the odd embouchures and estimated on the even ones.
# Flag columns: 1 = printed in BOLD (estimated by the thesis), 0 = standard font (measured).
